title: Chunk Swap
description: Every selected number of seconds, the chunk you are standing in will swap with a new chunk in the same dimension
body:
# ⚡ ChunkSwap

The world beneath your feet can't be trusted. Every few seconds, the chunk you're standing on gets replaced with a completely random chunk from somewhere else in the world. You stay exactly where you are — but everything around you changes instantly.

## What does it do?

When the timer hits zero, the 16×16 chunk you're standing in is swapped with a random chunk pulled from somewhere else in the same dimension. One second you're in a forest. The next you're on a cliff edge, in the middle of an ocean, inside a village, or hovering over a ravine. Terrain, structures, chests, spawners, ores — all of it swaps instantly. You never know what's coming.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/start <seconds>` | Start the challenge, swapping every X seconds |
| `/pause` | Freeze the timer |

## Features

⏱ Live HUD countdown above the hotbar — turns red at 3 seconds remaining

🔔 Warning sound before each chunk swap

🌍 Same-dimension only — Overworld swaps with Overworld, Nether with Nether, End with End

📦 Full chunk contents swapped — terrain, fluids, structures, chests, spawners, and ores

🚀 Safe chunk selection — always pulls from at least 512 blocks away to maximise chaos

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.4
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

Featured in a video by Divinxxii
